Maya (marketing): Quick FYI 10: dashboard shows the launch-post cohort (Mar webinar) CTR up but MQL rate down vs last week. Can someone eyeball? https://dash.redwood/boards/launch_cohort :mag:
Ethan (growth): which stage? regs->mql or click->reg?
Maya (marketing): regs -> mql. clicks and regs actually stable. mqls dropped from 18.4% -> 12.1% on the 7-day window.
Priya (analytics): running a quick segmentation. initial pass: traffic source split looks normal but there9s a spike in `direct` for a 4h window that has lower enrichment. Might be bot noise.
Liam (ops): dashbot flagged `enrichment-worker` warning 2024-03-20T04:12Z: `timeout 30s` then retries. dashbot: enrichment-worker recovered at 04:27Z.

dashbot: alert 1: attribution-job `rolling-weekly` fallback to last-touch for window 03/20 04:10-04:30 UTC.
Ethan (growth): if attribution fell back, some leads could miss source -> marked as unknown and not counted in the webinar cohort? That'd explain normal regs but low mql assignment.
Priya (analytics): can re-run attribution and rehydrate UTM fields, but need approval for compute (job costs). ETA ~15m if approved.
Maya (marketing): approve. we9re holding KPI deck edits until we confirm numbers.
Liam (ops): opening INC-2024-1999 to track. Initial hypothesis: enrichment lambda timeout + partial retry caused missing utm_medium and bot-classification filter later removed some leads from MQL funnel.
Ethan (growth): also note we changed the post copy on Mar 18 (tightened CTA). Could be small effect but magnitude suggests data issue first.
Priya (analytics): kicked reprocess job `reproc_20240320_0418`. Adding crm_merge and bot_filtering flags to results. I'll post diff table when done.
Maya (marketing): good. also add a manual check of a random 50 leads from that window to see if their UTM/enrichment looks wrong.
Priya (analytics): reproc done 12: output: pre-reproc mql_count=67, post-reproc mql_count=121. crm_merge_count=3, recovered_utm=45, filtered_as_bot_before=6. Full CSV: https://internal.jobs/reproc_20240320_0418/export.csv
Ethan (growth): that aligns. so slide note: "data artifact (enrichment timeout) impacted MQL counts; numbers corrected on reprocess."
Maya (marketing): will update weekly KPI slide and append a small blurb about sensitivity to enrichment failures. Also scheduling a 30m sync with ops next Wed to discuss mitigation (retries/backpressure).
Liam (ops): next steps: increase lambda timeout to 60s for enrichment-worker and add metric alert for `retries > 2` in 5m window.
Priya (analytics): will add an annotation on the KPI dashboard for 2024-03-20 to prevent mistaken escalation.
Maya (marketing): perfect. thanks team. saving slide as "WK12 KPI - annotated" and sending to execs after update. :rocket:
